terms

the short version. the long version is being written by a lawyer and will be here before launch.

the house is free. every door, every camp, every lesson. it stays free.

plus and the table are planned yearly or monthly subscriptions — not on sale during the pilot, when everything is free. once they launch: cancel in one tap; monthly stops at the end of the month, yearly runs out the year. the 100-day promise applies as written on its page.

the lessons are written by infinite hill from public-domain texts and checked by Keepers of each religion. they're ours; the scriptures are everyone's. please don't scrape, resell or republish the lessons.

what infinite hill isn't: a congregation, a clergy member, medical or mental-health care, or a substitute for any of them. we're not affiliated with any religious institution.

off-app events aren't running yet. when they are, they'll be run by their hosts, not by us, and they'll be 18+. our part will be checking hosts and listing nights; the room is theirs.

be kind. the golden rule applies in the app too.
